poolLimit.question: Does the bank pool have a per-company share limit?
poolLimit.answer: 50% - but bear in mind that the rules indicate this is checked before selling shares, after which you may sell as many shares as you wish in one block. This can result in more than 50% of the shares in the pool.

sameCompanyBuySell.question: Can you buy a certificate and immediately sell a certificate in the same company?
sameCompanyBuySell.answer: 1865 Sardinia, 1867, 1869 USA West, 1873, 1876-35 v2, 1880, 1893, 1895, 1898, 18Africa, 18Ardennes, 18BL, 18Chesapeake, 18CZ, 18EU, 18FL, 18GB, 18GL, 18IN, 18Ireland, 18Lilliput, 18Neb, 18NW, 18NYC, 18OE, 18PA, 18Rhl Rhineland, 18Ruhr, 18SA, 18Scan, 18SS, 18US, 18USA, 18VA, 18West, 2038, Railroad Barons, Steam Over Holland No. All selling precedes all buying.

roundEnd.question: What ends a share dealing round?
roundEnd.answer: Each player consecutively not making a purchase. The priority then goes to the player after the one who last made a purchase.

parPrice.question: How is a share company's initial (par) price determined?
parPrice.answer: Companies have fixed par prices. 1827 Jr, Crisis Unknown.

initialTile.question: Where can you make an initial tile lay?
initialTile.answer: As for 1830; in addition the Saarbrücker Eisenbahn and Rhein-Nahe-Bahn may only place yellow tiles on light red hexes, while the Pfalzbahn companies may only place yellow tiles on light green hexes (actually blue in my copies).

firstStationTiming.answer: The token is placed on the home base at the start of the operating round in which it will first run.
